newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Oct 13.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Oct 13.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bangladesh press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
A foreign minister-level meeting between Bangladesh and India will be held in New Delhi next month to further discuss water sharing of common river, the Ganges.
Ruling Awami League has accused the main opposition Bangladesh Nationlist Party (BNP) for creating a law and order situation in the country in a planned way to embarrass the government.

Opposition leader and former Prime Minister Begum Khaleda Zia leaves Dhaka on Sunday for Saudi Arabia to perform Umrah. She will be visiting the kingdom at the invitation of Saudi King Fahd-bin-Abdul Aziz.
World Bank President James Wolfensohn will visit Bangladesh next February or March to discuss speedy aid dibursement with the government in Dhaka, Finance Minister S A M S Kibria said.

The government is working on a law, Consumer Protection Act, to shield rights of consumers. A special committee, headed by a senior bureaucrat, was looking into the issue, said state minister law Abdul Matin Khasru.
